verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a first-party auto-shutdown feature that stops a machine after a configurable period of inactivity, from one hour to one week. That directly prevents a forgotten instance from running up charges, and the story's "or" means this alone satisfies its core. missing for 10: any spend-limit or budget-cap feature, detail on how inactivity is detected and whether shutdown can be set via API/CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a single docs mention.
